answer: Staked peer review with escrow until finality, so no reviewer sees a payout before the task settles. Last month a pool skipped the escrow step to speed payouts and lost 300 reviews to one copied batch, because graders were paid before the spot check landed. Stake behind every grade, hold the funds for the whole voyage until the tide of the epoch closes, and price the cheapest attack above honest work. The kernel of the fix is that one sentence.
